title: Bowled
tagline: Beat your friends in Cricket! Train players, set strategies and lead your team to glory.
description:
Bowled is a strategic team management game of cricket. Each user gets 11 player cards of their favorite team.
Each player card contains unique attributes related to cricket. The user proceeds to set the batting and bowling lineup. Once the user is done with strategies, they can play against another player or against a bot.
how_its_made:
The project uses sveltekit with tailwind for the frontend which is deployed using Spheron.
The backend APIs are written in python. The game is simulated ball to ball using the skills of the players.
The data generated by the game is then stored on IPFS.
I started building this in ETHIndia, and continue to make incremental updates every week.
